$comment: Theme pack: the info-graphics components re-skinned with the Tactile Paper Collage palette and fonts (library/styles/tactile-collage, MIT port; fonts Apache-2.0 / OFL, licences in that pack's fonts/). Token names are the info-graphics roles: orange = the collage signal red, good = resolve green, cream = paper, white = sheet. Use it in the same plan as tactile-collage items. Made for the split-screen + info-graphics + collage job on 2026-10-08.
label: Info-graphics in Paper Collage
use: Counters, equations, gauges, icons, orbits and word-timed type stacks in the paper collage look: warm paper, ink edges, signal red and resolve green, Archivo Black, Courier Prime and marker emphasis. Pair with tactile-collage paper, cards, stamps and tape.

display.$note: bundled heavy sans (the collage pack display face)

body.$note: Courier Prime Bold (OFL): labels, notes, posts

heavy.$note: Permanent Marker (Apache-2.0): the *emphasis* word in a stack with heavy=true

sfx.$note: Collage-quiet versions of the info-graphics sounds (the library has no paper sounds).
